title: Ġimgħa Stejjer Għat-Tfal
description: A special children's edition of our literary evening series, in partnership with Inizjamed. Featuring a reading by Leanne Ellul, face painting, a bouncy castle, and a free book for every child who attends. For children aged 5 to 12. Places are limited.

title: Festival tad-Dawl
description:
Mixja qasira mill-knisja sa ħdejn ħuġġieġa li ddawwal il pjazza b’numru ta’ tfajliet b’ilbies abjad, faxxa ħamra ma’ qaddhom u b’xemgħa f’idejhom jakkumpanjaw  
tfajla b’kuruna bix-xemgħat fuq rasha li tirrappreżenta lil Santa Luċija. Wara jitqassmu pasti ta’ Santa Luċija lil dawk preżenti // A short procession led by a young girl wearing a white  robe and a crown of candles, representing Saint Lucy (Lucija). Lucia is followed by a group of girls also dressed in white  
who walk across the village square accompanied by traditional music. A bonfire is lit to celebrate light and bring hope during the dark winter nights. Santa Lucija buns will be served tothose present.
